reviews.text: I used this app for years and all of a sudden it’s no longer working smh highly disappointed

reviews.title: Tired of the bait and switch
reviews.text: I’ve been using this for so many years and now they want a subscription that costs more than streaming tv. I only use it a few times per year. People who had this before should be allowed to continue using it for free. These devs use us to test it and then eventually charge us. I’ll use my now free Photoshop instead.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: This was my go to app for the last at least 5 years. Well I went in today and it’s doing absolutely NOTHING! The screen doesn’t  even move! So if I never reviewed the app once before, it would’ve been a 5 star rating. Now I have to find another platform which sucks to have to learn something over! Yay
